notes: True bit-perfect on macOS: the exclusive path now locks the hardware physical format (kAudioStreamPropertyPhysicalFormat) and reads it back, instead of only setting the HAL virtual format. Endpoints whose physical layer offers only float32 (built-in speakers, virtual devices) keep playing but honestly report “not bit-perfect” with the reason. Hog mode now defaults on, and its hint states that Hog does not block other apps. · macOS 真 bit-perfect：独占路径改为锁定硬件物理格式（kAudioStreamPropertyPhysicalFormat）并真实读回，不再只设 HAL 虚拟层。物理层只有 float32 的端点（内置扬声器、虚拟声卡）照常播放，但如实报「非 bit-perfect」并给出理由。Hog 独占默认开启，提示文案更正为「Hog 不能阻止其它 App 播放」。
